stories.story_fr: CMS Energy a réaffirmé ses prévisions d'EPS ajusté 2026 de 3,83 à 3,90 $ par action.
stories.story_en: CMS Energy reaffirmed its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $3.83 to $3.90 per share.
stories.quote: CMS Energy reaffirmed its 2026 adjusted earnings guidance of $3.83 to $3.90 per share

stories.story_fr: Le BPA ajusté du premier trimestre 2026 s'établit à 1,13 $, en hausse par rapport à 1,02 $ en 2025.
stories.story_en: Adjusted EPS for Q1 2026 was $1.13, up from $1.02 in 2025.
stories.quote: adjusted earnings per share for the first quarter were $1.13, compared to $1.02 per share for 2025

stories.story_fr: CMS Energy a relevé ses prévisions d'EPS ajusté 2026 à 3,83‑3,90 $ par action, au-dessus de la fourchette précédente.
stories.story_en: CMS Energy raised its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $3.83‑$3.90 from $3.80‑$3.87 per share.
stories.quote: CMS Energy raised its 2026 adjusted earnings guidance to $3.83 to $3.90 from $3.80 to $3.87 per share

stories.story_fr: La société a augmenté le dividende annuel de 11 cents, le portant à 2,28 $ par action pour 2026.
stories.story_en: The company increased its annual dividend by 11 cents to $2.28 per share for 2026.
stories.quote: CMS Energy also increased its annual dividend by 11 cents per share to $2.28 for 2026

stories.story_fr: Les résultats supérieurs de NorthStar Clean Energy ont largement contribué à dépasser les prévisions d'EPS ajusté.
stories.story_en: Outperformance at NorthStar Clean Energy largely drove the adjusted EPS beat.
stories.quote: exceeding the guidance range largely due to outperformance at NorthStar Clean Energy
